Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a single landscape 16:9 still concept mock for Lanterns Beyond the Grave, intended for a later quiet Halloween animation.
Input image 1 is a mood and drawing-language reference ONLY: borrow its black night, muted warm sepia ink, simple readable silhouettes and localized candle light. Do not reproduce the cats, pumpkin, group arrangement or exact scene.
Input image 2 is the original keeper character identity reference: retain a small gentle hooded ghostlike lantern keeper, pale oval face with two small black dot eyes and no mouth, plain muted taupe cloak and dark little boots. Reinterpret with cleaner bolder ink shapes for thumbnail readability.
Style: hand-drawn antique Halloween storybook woodcut / pen-and-ink illustration, restrained fine hatching inside subject, subtle paper grain, simple graphic silhouette. Cozy eerie mood.
Color: ONLY near-black, one muted warm taupe/sepia midtone, and pale amber candle light. Pale face is the lightest area after the small candle. Majority of image is true nighttime black or very dark brown. No greens, blues, colorful sky, orange sunset, pale daytime background, luminous moon or scattered bright color accents.
Visual hierarchy: keeper face, cloak silhouette and lantern must read immediately at small thumbnail size. Clear contour contrast along head and shoulders; background lower contrast and far fewer details than the reference. Local candle pool only. No dense foliage, intricate architecture, competing textures or light sources.
One complete standalone image, not a collage or contact sheet. No words, numbers, captions, signature, logo, watermark or border.
Composition for this distinct mock: The keeper sits on a single low stone at center-left of a forest clearing, large in frame, holding the lantern at knee height. Only three almost-black tree trunks at the far edges and two tiny grave silhouettes far behind. A small oval amber light pool defines the ground. Balanced wide composition with generous black space behind the entire character.
